title: DMAP-AI Knowledge Center
description: Scientific articles, tutorials, and reference documentation for drought monitoring, drought indices, drought severity, wavelet analysis, climate datasets, and AI-assisted drought interpretation.

categories.title: Drought Basics

categories.title: Drought Events and Severity

categories.title: Climate Data
categories.description: Precipitation, temperature, evapotranspiration, remote sensing, and reanalysis datasets.

categories.title: Wavelet Analysis
categories.description: Wavelet scalograms, global spectra, coherence, periodicity, and time-frequency drought diagnostics.

categories.title: Analysis Methods
categories.description: Probability distributions, trend analysis, event detection, copulas, uncertainty, and validation.

categories.title: AI Interpretation
categories.description: Structured metadata, chart-specific AI prompts, hallucination reduction, and explainable drought reporting.

categories.title: Applications
categories.description: Agriculture, water resources, urban planning, ecosystem drought, and operational decision support.

categories.title: Case Studies
categories.description: Station-based, farm-scale, and regional drought examples using DMAP-AI workflows.
